scope: Optional reviewed single-image material estimates and bounded inclined-plane candidates. Twelve cached baseline replays plus two actual reviewed candidate conversions. No new native shape inference, independent photograph evaluation or physical build.

limits: Single-image paint and illumination can be ambiguous; this is an inferred candidate, not material ground truth.
The model can brighten real dark paint, shift hue and smooth fine texture. Equal-radiance controls with opposite paint explanations produce identical predictions.
Observed reference pixels remain the source evidence. A finite or stable prediction does not validate paint preservation, geometry or physical buildability.

warnings: Learned albedo is a material hypothesis, not verified paint. Identical radiance can represent different materials and illumination. Genuine dark paint and fine texture may change; compare with source colors before converting.

order.scope: Final one-plate grid approach; full paths, hands and stability unverified.

warnings: Nearly planar patches are a bounded mesh design inference. Unseen topology, intrinsic material, curved-part selection and load strength are not established.

sourceConservation: Production applyMaterialHypothesis replay asserted exact source geometry/camera/features/observation object preservation, RGBA equality and observed coverage equality. New material palette evidence is separate from the original ledger.

controls.scope: No production integration. Six diagnostic synthetic controls; same official pinned model, MPS float32, 4 steps, 512 processing resolution, ensemble1, seed735.

ambiguousPair.reason: Same radiance and seed cannot identify opposite paint-versus-lighting ground truth. This is ambiguity, not proof of correct paint.

controls.reason: Diagnostic controls are finite but genuine dark paint is brightened and texture weakened; opposite material explanations with equal pixels remain ambiguous.

limits.images: Bilinear offline downsample approximates canvas; no browser UI, load stability, or physical build was tested. Connection checks are not visual quality scores.
limits.geometry: Recess walls use mesh-and-reference evidence; lower display platforms use reconstructed mesh normals and area consensus. Only declared patches are redesigned. Source material patterns, inferred back geometry, procurement, load strength and insertion paths remain unverified.
limits.support: Fewer support parts is not a strength result. Negative spaces, material regions, curve design, procurement, full paths, force/stability and human instructions trials remain incomplete. Public engine examples are not independent held-out photographs.
limits.procurement: Catalog records establish previously observed part/color combinations. They do not verify current stock, authenticity of seller listings, legal assembly poses, forces, stability, physical build or human instructions. Assembly grouping is a procurement count only; existing split steps require review.
limits.slopes: Source-evidenced upright slopes only. Unobserved backs, curved surface design, material inference, kit appearance, procurement, full insertion paths, joint force and human step trials remain incomplete.

renderReview.renderer: scripts/render-assembly.py / actual vendored part geometry; no edited mockup

findings.improved: Front brown jamb/fascia/stair shadow bands visibly reduced. Statue and both connected visible braziers retained.
findings.remaining: Back retains brown areas, staircase-like inferred structure and uneven layout. Top/ground still has inconsistent surface pattern.

findings.improved: Some scattered white roof fragments reduced; blue roof and gray masonry remain represented.
findings.remaining: Roof remains stepped rather than curved. Gray wall/blue roof correspondence, yellow ground and inferred back remain incorrect. Whole-region objective failed.

surfaceGeometry.method: connected inclined-plane candidate with fixed original camera and final-intersection veto
surfaceGeometry.scope: Existing axis design retained; conservative new candidates. No claim that two real failing meshes now have a complete regional design.
surfaceGeometry.controls: Inclined noise, curved wave preservation, boundary/crease preservation, thin sheet collision, orientation, bounds, fixed-camera projection and rejected repaint controls covered by focused tests.
surfaceGeometry.limits: Endpoint intersections only; not continuous motion or a minimum-gap guarantee. Existing source intersections and incident contacts are excluded. Ledger is detached by ownership, not runtime-writable typed-array protection.

limitations: Public engine samples are not independent held-out photos.
Silhouette camera and original pixel mapping are recorded, not proven correct internally.
Changing paint can change packing; fewer parts or connected output is not a force/stability result.
Remaining 245 baseline procurement lines unverified; catalog snapshot is not stock.
Full insertion paths, subassembly instructions, step visibility and human trials remain incomplete.
